bio: Please specify “Tipsy Tea” in the Special Requests box.  Discover K West Hotel & Spa's Tipsy Tea featuring three cocktails based on traditional Afternoon Tea flavours - the Classic Cucumber Sandwich, Sweet Victoria Sponge and Strawberry Jam to finish.  Cocktails are made to share in glass teapots, paired with a cheese & meat platter and served in style on a retro record turntable.  Available daily in Studio Bar from 4 - 9pm, priced at £59 per person. Minimum two people per booking, including welcome glass of prosecco, three teapot cocktails and a cheese & meat platter to share.  Please be informed that the venue welcome card payments only. Should you have food allergies/special dietary requirements please ask your server for assistance. (V) = Vegetarian. (VG) = Vegan. (GF) = Gluten Free. Menu items may contain nuts or trace elements. Prices include VAT. A discretionary gratuity of 12.5% will be added to your bill. A
